name: Salinger
authors: Mirela Belova, Stan Partalev, Luboslav Boyanov

raw.designer: Mirela Belova, Stan Partalev, Luboslav Boyanov
raw.description:
Salinger is a classical serif family designed for reading, balancing familiar proportions with a warm, distinctive voice. Sturdy main strokes, fine details, softly bracketed serifs and rounded terminals give it an elegant yet welcoming feel. The upright styles are composed and legible; the true italic has fluid, calligraphic forms.

The family includes six weights in upright and true italic, with OpenType swashes, ligatures and alternates. Supporting Latin, Extended Latin, Cyrillic and Greek, Salinger works beautifully for books and editorial design, while its expressive italic adds character to headlines, branding and packaging.
